prompt: The base Transformer trains for only 12 hours on 8 GPUs. On WMT 2014 English-German, how do you expect it to compare with the best earlier systems, including ensembles of several models?
options: It falls behind them; only the larger big model catches up.
It roughly ties the best earlier single models but trails the ensembles.
It scores above every earlier system, ensembles included.

private.resolution: Even the base model, at 27.3 BLEU, beats every previously published model and ensemble on English-German, at a fraction of their training cost. The big model widens the gap to more than 2 BLEU.
